name: brain
description: Amnesia Labs internal alpha. Invite only.
changelog: v0.10.0 — session hooks need no configuration: they reuse the Brain login Claude Code already holds for the plugin's MCP server (read-only from Claude Code's credential store; expired access tokens are refreshed with the stored offline token and cached in ~/.cache/brain-mcp). Removes bin/get-brain-token.sh and the KEYCLOAK_TOKEN_URL/CLIENT_ID/CLIENT_SECRET requirement, which made every portal-onboarded user see 'Brain: auth failed' and silently skipped session saves (issue #1). Hook failures now say why and how to fix it (/mcp). Prior: v0.9.2 loa3 JWT cache poisoning fix.
